name: auto-code-review
description: Evidence-first AI code review for Git changes, using the coding agent you already trust.

interface.longDescription: Review staged, uncommitted, branch, commit, or file changes with an evidence-first workflow that verifies failure scenarios, filters speculation, and produces consistent prioritized findings.
defaultPrompt: Review my current Git changes and report only verified defects.
Review this branch against main for correctness and security regressions.
Produce a structured JSON review of my staged changes.
